root_cause_analysis.symptom: Attachment migration stuck at 13,432/51,816 with 19,806+ failures (same 83 attachments retried ~238 times in infinite loop)

root_causes.cause: Emergent Object Storage upload service returning 500 Internal Server Error for ALL uploads (reads/lists still work)
root_causes.details: Even a tiny 5-byte text file upload fails. Init and list operations work fine. The storage write capability is completely down.

root_causes.cause: No failure marking: failed attachments were never marked in DB, causing the same batch to retry indefinitely
root_causes.fix: Added migration_retries counter and storage_path='FAILED' marking after 3 retries

root_causes.cause: No circuit breaker: migration continued burning resources even when storage was completely unavailable
root_causes.fix: Added circuit breaker that pauses migration after 3 consecutive full-batch failures, with storage health probe before retry

root_causes.cause: Query didn't exclude failed attachments: $regex on attachments.url matched all unmigrated attachments including already-failed ones
root_causes.fix: Changed to $elemMatch query that requires BOTH url match AND storage_path not exists

root_causes.cause: Malformed URL 'https: files.atlas.so=' would never download but kept retrying

fixes_applied: Added MAX_ATTACHMENT_RETRIES (3) — attachments marked storage_path='FAILED' after exhausting retries
Added circuit breaker (MAX_CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES=3) — pauses 5 min, runs storage health probe before retry
Added _storage_health_probe() — tests storage upload before resuming batches
Changed query to $elemMatch — only finds messages with genuinely unmigrated attachments
Added _should_migrate() URL validation — rejects malformed URLs
Added reset_failed_attachments() API — allows bulk reset when storage is restored
next_steps: Storage service needs to be restored (external dependency)
Once storage is back: POST /api/admin/atlas/attachments/reset-failed to retry all failed attachments
Migration will auto-resume via circuit breaker health probe
overall_status: PASS (code fixes verified, blocked on external service)
